title: Integer Division Without Division Operator

content.problemStatement: Divide the given two numbers and print the quotient without using / operator.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the corresponding formatted output according to problem rules.
Input produces the corresponding formatted output according to problem rules.

solution.approach: Divide two numbers without using the / operator using repeated subtraction or bit manipulation.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Subtract the divisor from the dividend repeatedly while dividend >= divisor, counting subtractions.

hints: Count how many subtractions were performed.
The count is the integer quotient.
learningObjectives: Understand relation between division and repeated subtraction.
